editorial:
Imagine being a top-tier hitman who only cares about one person in the world. That is exactly the life Kiri lives. She spends her days taking out targets for her boss, but her heart belongs to Rui, a girl she loves like a little sister. Both girls went through the same brutal training, but a tragedy changed everything. After a terrible attack leaves Kiri's mother dead and Rui without her voice or her hand, the movie turns into a high-stakes mission for payback. It feels like a classic revenge story where the main character has a set of deadly skills and a very personal reason to use them.

What really makes this ride fun is the action. The fight scenes are snappy and keep you on your toes, though some of the plot beats feel a bit predictable. If you enjoy fast movement and strong female leads, you will love this. To get the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see every detail of the fights. If you are a fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a great move for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Kiri finally tracks down the people responsible for the pain she and Rui suffered. After a series of intense fights, she takes out the villains to clear the debt of blood. The story wraps up with Kiri finding a sense of peace, knowing she protected Rui. It ends on a hopeful note, showing that while they cannot erase the past, they can move forward together as a family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves female-led action movies and revenge plots.
